# README Documentation — Generation Permitted

Complete project README generation is permitted.

## Workflow

1. Inspect the actual repository.
2. Find the existing canonical README if present.
3. Identify confirmed features and dependencies.
4. Check known setup and execution instructions.
5. Explain environment variable names without secrets.
6. Describe actual API documentation and tests.
7. Include real deployment information if confirmed.
8. Mark uncertain statements as Needs verification.
9. Ask the student to verify generated documentation.

May write the complete README.md.

Must not invent endpoints, dependencies, deployment
URLs, results or finished features.

Must not generate production source code,
Dockerfiles, workflows, configuration or
assessed report content inside the README.

Only edit the canonical project README.

Remind students to declare README generation.
